escalation.role: escalation target — fleet-best classification/reasoning. MLX int4, 64% faster than GGUF.

adversarial_challenger.role: Aragorn adversarial challenger — cross-family (Gemma) MoE breaks correlated Qwen failure modes

first_pass.role: daily extraction and scoring. MLX nvfp4, 53% faster than GGUF, quality within noise.

triage.role: cheap binary gate — reject obviously irrelevant items before extraction. GGUF (nvfp4 quality too low).

legolas.scope: all tiers up to 36GB for 48GB M5 Pro — upgrades and new size tiers
requirements: Supports disabling internal reasoning (think: false or equivalent)
Benchmarks competitively at its size tier
Fits within 36GB single-model budget (48GB M5 Pro)

candidates.key_strengths: Thinking OFF by default, 256K context, new Gated DeltaNet arch
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Adopted as triage gate (GGUF). nvfp4 quality too low.

candidates.key_strengths: Thinking OFF by default, 256K context, strong extraction at small size
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Evaluated — strong quality (0.94 extraction), MLX nvfp4 variant kept as reserve

candidates.key_strengths: Thinking OFF by default, MMMU-Pro 69% vs qwen3-8B 57%, 256K context
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Adopted as first-pass (nvfp4 MLX variant). Replaces qwen3:8b.

candidates.key_strengths: Dense 27B, 3GB smaller than qwen3:32b, better benchmarks, 256K context
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Adopted as escalation target (int4 MLX variant). Replaces qwen3:32b.

candidates.key_strengths: MoE 256 experts, 3B active = fast inference, claims to surpass qwen3-235B
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Evaluated — outscores 27b on all dims, 5x faster. int4 MLX variant kept as potential escalation upgrade.

candidates.key_strengths: MoE 128 experts + 1 shared, 3.8B active, AIME 88.3%, MMLU-Pro 82.6%, native function calling, 256K context, Apache 2.0
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Adopted as Aragorn adversarial challenger. Cross-family diversity, causal 0.90, nuanced 0.88.

candidates.key_strengths: Dense 31B, AIME 89.2%, MMLU-Pro 85.2%, LiveCodeBench 80%, Codeforces ELO 2150, native function calling, 256K context, Apache 2.0, #3 on Arena AI text leaderboard
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Evaluated — strong but 6903s eval time (too slow). Kept as reserve dense Gemma option.

candidates.key_strengths: Edge-optimized, MMLU-Pro 69.4%, native function calling, 128K context, multimodal (text+image+audio), Apache 2.0
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Evaluated — strong classification (1.0), decent reasoning. Kept as reserve cross-family fast-tier option.

candidates.key_strengths: Improved instruction following, robust function calling template, 128K context, multimodal (text+image), less repetition than 3.1
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Downloaded, not yet evaluated on Perian suite. Third-family diversity candidate.

candidates.key_strengths: Upgraded agentic coding (SWE-bench), thinking preservation across context history, 262K context, multimodal (text/image)
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Potential dense upgrade for the escalation target (qwen3.5:27b-int4). Excellent for complex structured coding tasks.

candidates.key_strengths: Sparse MoE architecture (3B active), high reasoning efficiency, thinking preservation, 262K context, fast inference
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Potential MoE upgrade for escalation or heavy-moe tier, replacing or complementing qwen3.5:35b-a3b.

candidates.key_strengths: Edge-optimized, native function calling, 128K context window, multimodal (text/image/audio), Apache 2.0
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Provides a cross-family (Gemma) edge alternative to triage (qwen3.5:2b) or fast-tier candidates (gemma4:e4b).

candidates.key_strengths: State-of-the-art 14B SLM from Microsoft, MIT license, strong mathematics, logic, and instruction following, native function calling
candidates.comparison_to_fleet: Provides a third-family (Microsoft Phi) alternative in the small/medium tier, complementing the first-pass Qwen model.
